old: Somalia does not yet operate a full value-added tax. Instead a 5% Sales Tax applies to most goods and services, collected at the point of sale, with a formal VAT system under development with international assistance. Since 18 August 2024 the Federal Ministry of Finance has applied a split-payment mechanism so the tax is remitted immediately at the time of sale.
